title: Violet_City
lead_summary:
Violet City can be accessed from the West via Route 36, the South via Route 32, and the East via Route 31.
This city contains Violet City's Gym, with Falkner as its leader. To the North of the town is the Sprout Tower, and to the East is the Pokémon School.

items.name: Fresh Water
items.location_details: Given by the man inside the gym.

items.name: Energy Root
items.location_details: On a island East of the Sprout Tower.

items.name: Sun Stone
items.location_details: At the top of the waterfall.

items.name: Super Incubator
items.location_details: Given by the woman in the hotel after getting rid of the Pineco along the path to [[Cherrygrove City]].

items.name: Slowpoke Tail
items.location_details:
Found in a random patch of flowers after starting the quest for the Youngster in the hotel.
''(Due to a bug, two of the possible locations are not on flower tiles. These two locations are on the island between the two bridges leading to Sprout Tower.)''

items.name: XXX Defense 3
items.location_details: Given by the Youngster in the hotel after giving him a Slowpoke Tail.

items.name: Sky Plate
items.location_details: North of the school, after catching [[Legendary_Pokémon#Arceus
